OnePlus is reportedly shutting down its global operations by April 2026, marking the end of an iconic Android brand outside China.

In this video, we break down what led to this shocking decision, the role of OPPO, what happens to future devices, and what it means for Android users worldwide.

Is this truly the end of OnePlus as we know it—or just a transformation under a new name?
